title: Prefix sums and a hash map
summary: Count subarrays summing to target, negatives allowed. Seed the empty prefix {0: 1}; look up prefix - target before recording prefix. O(n).
code: # A previous prefix equal to prefix - target starts a match.
triggers: count (or longest) subarrays whose sum or xor is exactly k
negative numbers, so a sliding window can't tell when to shrink
prompts: Daily balance changes can be positive or negative. Count the runs of consecutive days whose changes net to exactly zero.
A sensor reports signed adjustments. How many contiguous stretches of readings add up to a given drift?
invariant: When a value is read, counts[p] is how many earlier prefixes, the empty one included, sum to p.
mantra: Look up prefix - target, then record prefix.
pitfalls: Seed {0: 1}, or subarrays that start at index 0 are missed.
Look up before recording: the other order counts the empty subarray when target is 0.
Negative values break sliding windows; that's why this uses a map.

anchors.name: Contiguous Array
anchors.trick: Treat 0 as -1, store each prefix's first index, find the longest zero-sum span.

anchors.name: Continuous Subarray Sum
anchors.trick: Store prefix % k with its first index; a repeat two or more apart is a hit.

anchors.name: Range Sum Query - Immutable
anchors.trick: prefix[j] - prefix[i] answers each query in O(1).

mutations.explanation: Without the empty prefix, subarrays that start at index 0 are never counted.
Wrong complement: prefix - earlier == target means earlier == prefix - target.
